world.title: Pakistan-US relations: Why Democrats' midterm win worries Asim Munir, Shehbaz Sharif
world.summary: Pakistan's leaders, including Asim Munir and Shehbaz Sharif, express concerns over the implications of the Democrats' midterm victory for US-Pakistan relations. The new administration may scrutinize deals involving Donald Trump's family and associates, potentially complicating ties. Karachi resident Sajjad Ali emphasized that peace and economic improvement in Pakistan hinge on a change in the US government.

world.title: Iran distributes iodine pills near nuclear sites as Trump weighs fresh strikes: Report
world.summary: Iran has begun distributing iodine tablets to residents near its nuclear facilities in response to heightened concerns about a potential US military strike. This move comes as tensions escalate, with reports indicating that former President Trump is considering new military actions. The distribution aims to protect citizens from potential radiation exposure in the event of an attack.

world.title: 'Depicts humanity at its most grotesque': Why the 300-year-old novel Gulliver's Travels is so misunderstood
world.summary: Jonathan Swift's "Gulliver's Travels," published in 1726, has been extensively adapted and interpreted over the centuries. The novel is often debated as either a "misanthropic satire" or a "fantastical nursery tale." The story follows Lemuel Gulliver's adventures, highlighting themes of human nature and society. Its complexity and depth contribute to ongoing misunderstandings about its true intent and meaning.

business.title: Royal Enfield Flying Flea Enters Chennai With 14 Sales And Service Touchpoints
business.summary: Royal Enfield's electric mobility brand, Flying Flea, has launched in Chennai, marking it as the fourth Indian market after Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune. The company has set up 14 sales and service touchpoints in the city to support its operations. This expansion reflects Royal Enfield's commitment to growing its presence in the electric vehicle sector in India.

business.title: NMC founder BR Shetty held liable for $5.4 billion healthcare fraud by Abu Dhabi court
business.summary: NMC founder BR Shetty was found liable for a $5.4 billion healthcare fraud by the Abu Dhabi court. Justice Sir Andrew Smith determined that Shetty and Manghat knowingly engaged in fraudulent activities, including misappropriating company funds and manipulating financial records. However, the court did not rule on allegations against Bank of Baroda due to a settlement.

business.title: AI, electricity bills and voter anger: How data centres tanked Trump's midterm hopes
business.summary: America's AI revolution aimed to enhance power and economic strength, but the infrastructure supporting it has negatively impacted voter sentiment. Rising electricity bills and concerns over data centers have fueled discontent, particularly among voters in key states. This backlash is seen as a factor that undermined former President Trump's midterm election prospects, complicating the political landscape.

technology.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 And Warzone Season 1 Go Live, Bringing Fixes And DMZ Changes
technology.summary: Season 1 of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone is now live, introducing various fixes and changes. The update addresses issues with Loadouts after Prestiging and ensures completed Events count towards the Event Mastery Camo Challenge. Additionally, several weapon problems have been resolved, enhancing gameplay and user experience in both Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone.

technology.title: Is Your Bedroom Light Damaging Your Heart? What A New Study Reveals
technology.summary: A new study indicates that nighttime light exposure exceeding three lux may negatively impact heart health. Researchers found that individuals with higher light exposure were more prone to thickening of the left ventricle wall, the heart's main pumping chamber. This suggests that both sleep duration and sleep environment play crucial roles in overall health and well-being.

technology.title: Connected Headphones That Play Music Without a Smartphone; Sony Goes Back to Walkman Roots With USB
technology.summary: Sonos has introduced its second-generation headphones, the Sonos Ace Ultra, which allow users to stream music directly over Wi-Fi without needing a smartphone. This innovation marks a return to the company's roots, reminiscent of the Walkman era. The headphones aim to enhance user convenience by providing a standalone music experience, reflecting advancements in wireless audio technology.

sports.title: Hridoy's record 242* gives Bangladesh improbable lead
sports.summary: Towhid Hridoy scored an unbeaten 242 runs, marking the highest individual score in Tests by a Bangladeshi batter. This achievement places him among only four players from Bangladesh to reach a double-century, joining Mushfiqur Rahim, Tamim Iqbal, and Shakib Al Hasan. Hridoy's performance helped Bangladesh recover from a significant deficit to gain a 30-run lead on the third day.

sports.title: 'I'll stay a jobless loser': Delhi employee loses job ahead of Diwali, says company ruined festival
sports.summary: A Delhi marketing professional was laid off just before Diwali, expressing frustration over the timing of the job loss. The individual took to Reddit to share their experience and seek assistance in finding a new marketing position. The sudden job loss has overshadowed the festive season, which is typically associated with celebration and new opportunities.

sports.title: Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono considering retirement after fatal collision that claimed life of Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel
sports.summary: Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono is contemplating retirement after the tragic death of Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel, who died following an on-field collision. The incident has profoundly affected Owono, leaving him distressed. He is currently seeking support from his club and the wider football community as he navigates the psychological impact of this event on his career.

health.title: How to biohack flu season and avoid getting sick
health.summary: To avoid getting sick during flu season, experts suggest several preventive measures. Immunologists recommend biohacking strategies that enhance immune function, such as maintaining a balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate sleep, and stress management. Additionally, vaccinations and good hygiene practices are crucial. By implementing these steps, individuals can potentially reduce their risk of contracting influenza and improve overall health.

health.title: How new genomic tools can help detect rare DNA changes
health.summary: Researchers at Washington University School of Medicine have confirmed the effectiveness of new genomic tools in identifying rare DNA changes within an individual's genomic mosaic. This advancement is significant for understanding how these genetic variants influence health and disease. The study represents a key development in the national effort to explore the implications of small DNA alterations.

health.title: Prediabetes And Festive Eating: 7 Things To Do After Dinner To Control Blood Sugar
health.summary: Prediabetes can be managed effectively, potentially preventing progression to type 2 diabetes. During festive seasons, individuals with prediabetes should be mindful of their food choices, particularly regarding sugary and fried items. After meals, specific actions can help control blood sugar levels. Timely interventions can restore glucose levels to normal and significantly lower the risk of developing diabetes.

science.title: Tagore has a dinosaur named after him. So does the man who dug it up
science.summary: Scientists named the early Jurassic dinosaur Barapasaurus tagorei in honor of Rabindranath Tagore’s birth centenary. Sohan Lal Jain, who contributed to its documentation, was later recognized with the name Jainosaurus. This connection highlights the intersection of literature and geology in Indian palaeontology, showcasing the significance of both figures in the discovery of this dinosaur in central India.

science.title: Earth has a new mini-moon: a 1-metre space rock named 2026 QQ8 was pulled into orbit around our planet in April, was spotted in August, and will stay until about December before drifting off on its ow
science.summary: Earth has a new temporary mini-moon, a 1-meter space rock named 2026 QQ8. It was captured by Earth's gravity in April 2026 and remained undetected until August. This small celestial body is expected to orbit Earth until approximately December 2026, after which it will drift away into space. Its presence highlights the dynamic nature of near-Earth objects.

science.title: Humans collectively exhale over 2 billion metric tons CO2 annually
science.summary: Humans collectively exhale over 2 billion metric tons of carbon dioxide annually, primarily due to population growth. This significant contribution to the natural carbon cycle has increased by 74% since 1985. The findings highlight the impact of human metabolism on CO2 levels, emphasizing the role of human activity in environmental changes related to carbon emissions.

entertainment.title: Kajal Aggarwal on playing Mandodari in 'Ramayana': 'It is an immense moment of pride to be associated with a magnum opus like Ramayan'
entertainment.summary: Kajal Aggarwal expressed her pride in portraying Mandodari in Nitesh Tiwari’s film ‘Ramayana’ through a heartfelt social media post. Despite her role being small, she emphasized the significance of being associated with such a monumental project. Aggarwal's sentiments reflect her appreciation for the opportunity to contribute to the retelling of this classic tale.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor’s Boyfriend Shikhar Pahariya Joins Khushi’s Birthday Bash On Video Call
entertainment.summary: Khushi Kapoor celebrated her 26th birthday with a family gathering featuring a butterfly-themed setup and a beautiful cake. The event included close friends and family, creating an intimate atmosphere. Notably, Janhvi Kapoor's boyfriend, Shikhar Pahariya, joined the celebration via video call, adding a special touch to the occasion. The celebration highlighted Khushi's connections with loved ones.

entertainment.title: Ramayana Actor Satyen Chaturvedi Says He Remains Grateful After His Scenes Were Cut From Ranbir Kapoor's Film
entertainment.summary: Actor Satyen Chaturvedi expressed gratitude for his involvement in Nitesh Tiwari's film "Ramayana: Part 1," despite his scenes being cut. The film, released on November 5, stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Yash as Ravana, featuring a large ensemble cast. Chaturvedi emphasized the positive experience he gained from participating in the project, regardless of the editing decisions.
